web.title: Bukayo Saka
web.description:
## Club career
### 2020–2022: Back-to-back Arsenal Player of the Season
On 19 March 2022, Saka scored Arsenal's 2000th Premier League goal in history, as the Gunners defeated [Aston Villa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aston_Villa_F.C.) 1–0 away at [Villa Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Villa_Park).

### 2022–2026: Title challengers and eventual Champions
[[86]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bukayo_Saka#cite_note-87)[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bukayo_Saka#cite_note-88) On 11 February 2024, Saka surpassed 50 goals for Arsenal with a brace in a 6–0 away win over West Ham, becoming the youngest Arsenal player to do so in the Premier League.

On 4 October 2025, Saka made his 200th Premier League appearance for Arsenal in a 2–0 win over West Ham United, scoring a penalty — his 55th league goal and 100th goal involvement for the club in the competition.
